# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 31 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam's Final Words to His Children

---

**31:1** Adam called Seth and said: 'My son, I am near death. Hear my final words and keep them.'

**31:2** 'After I die, let no one mourn for me more than six days, for the seventh day is the sign of the resurrection — the day of rest from all toil.'

**31:3** Adam blessed Seth and said: 'May the Lord God bless you and your descendants for all generations.'

---
